play.definition: A vertical double-move pass concept in which the primary receiver releases upfield, sells an inside slant break, then plants and redirects vertically to create separation from a defender who reacts to the initial inside movement. The quarterback times a deep throw after the receiver transitions back upfield, while complementary routes occupy underneath and deep coverage defenders.

Action_CloseOnQuarterback.label: Close On Quarterback
Action_CloseOnQuarterback.definition: A defender's pass-rush action of reducing the space to the quarterback after defeating or clearing a blocker, moving into immediate pressure or tackling range.

Action_PreSnap.label: Pre Snap
Action_PreSnap.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.

Action_SackQuarterback.label: Sack Quarterback
Action_SackQuarterback.definition: A defender's successful action of bringing the quarterback to the ground or causing the quarterback to be ruled down behind the line of scrimmage on a passing play.
